samples.summary: New `afterNamedStyleChange` wiring on all four named-style entry points has no test
samples.evidence: `afterNamedStyleChange()` now replaces the refresh tail of `setDocStyles`, `updateStyleToMatch`, `resetNamedStyle` and `resetAllNamedStyles` (editor.ts:2840/2870/2875/2880) and adds a whole-document cleanup pass. The only tests for the cleanup call `doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll()` directly (packages/docs/test/model/document.test.ts:390-427); nothing drives it through an EditorAPI named-style entry point, so a wiring regression (e.g. one of the four paths reverting to `doc.refresh()`, or the cleanup running before the store write) would not fail any test. I grepped the whole repo for `afterNamedStyleChange`, `dropStaleStyleOffAll`, `setDocStyles`, `resetNamedStyle`, `resetAllNamedStyles`, `updateStyleToMatch` and inspected packages/docs/test/store/named-styles.test.ts (store-level only) and packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar-header-footer.test.tsx.

samples.summary: Internal-clipboard paste now runs a whole-document style sweep with no test
samples.evidence: The internal WAFFLEDOCS_MIME paste branch gained `this.doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll()` (text-editor.ts:1264), a document-wide mutating pass on the paste path. No test covers it: `packages/docs/test/view/clipboard.test.ts` contains no `italic: false`/`bold: false` fixtures (grepped `italic: false|bold: false|underline: false|strikethrough: false` across packages/docs/test — only document.test.ts and text-box-editor.ts matches), and the two harnesses that do drive an internal paste (test/view/image-paste-merge.test.ts, test/view/list-heading-roundtrip.test.ts) paste payloads with no explicit boolean-off flags, so the new call is a no-op there and cannot fail.
searchedFor: read packages/docs/test/view/clipboard.test.ts grep for internal paste

samples.summary: Format painter's named-style fallback (`raw[key] ?? defaults[key]`) is untested
samples.evidence: `captureFormatAtCursor` bakes the *effective* boolean, falling back to the block's named-style defaults so painting from an italic Heading 6 does not emit `italic: false`. The only painter tests (packages/docs/test/view/backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:815, :843) copy from a plain paragraph whose run carries `italic: true` explicitly, so `defaults[key]` is never consulted; deleting the `?? defaults[key]` term would keep both tests green. No test copies format from a heading/named-styled source (grepped for `'c', { shiftKey` and `styleBuffer` across packages/docs/test — only those two sites).

The method explicitly walks `_document.header`, `_document.footer` and recurses into (nested) table cells (document.ts:505-514), but both new tests (test/model/document.test.ts:391-427) use a single body paragraph. Removing the header/footer/table recursion entirely would leave the suite green.

samples.summary: The single-undo-unit claim for the stale-flag sweep (`applyStyles` batch) is unasserted
samples.evidence: `writeStaleStyleOffEdits` documents that batching through `store.applyStyles` keeps a block-type change or style redefinition as one undo step. No test performs undo after the sweep: grep for `applyStyles` shows only src usages plus packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/editor-step-selection-font-size-undo.test.ts (an unrelated path). Switching the batch back to a loop of `applyStyle` would not fail any test.

`rangeCarriesLink` has a dedicated `from === to` branch (document.ts:47-52) for a caret sitting on a link boundary. The only link test (test/model/document.test.ts:368-386) uses a 0..6 non-collapsed range, so the collapsed branch is dead in the suite; grep of packages/docs/test for `href` + collapsed style application found no covering case.

samples.summary: Newly exported `resolveScriptExclusion` has no unit test in the docs package
samples.evidence: The function is exported from packages/docs (index.ts:99, node.ts:139) for reuse by the Yorkie store, but packages/docs/test/store/block-helpers.test.ts has no superscript/subscript case (grep for `superscript|subscript` in packages/docs/test lists layout/paint/clipboard/markdown/document/types/docx tests, not block-helpers). Only the frontend tree test (yorkie-doc-store.test.ts:239) covers the exclusion, so the docs-side contract of the extracted helper is unguarded.

samples.summary: 'writes nothing' is asserted only via the return value
samples.evidence: The test named 'leaves an override its style still supplies, and writes nothing' asserts `dropStaleStyleOffAll()` returns false and that the run still has `italic: false`. It never observes the store (e.g. spying on `applyStyles` or comparing a document revision), so a version that wrote a redundant no-op patch and still returned false would pass under this name.

finding.summary: New `afterNamedStyleChange` wiring on all four named-style entry points has no test
finding.evidence: `afterNamedStyleChange()` now replaces the refresh tail of `setDocStyles`, `updateStyleToMatch`, `resetNamedStyle` and `resetAllNamedStyles` (editor.ts:2840/2870/2875/2880) and adds a whole-document cleanup pass. The only tests for the cleanup call `doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll()` directly (packages/docs/test/model/document.test.ts:390-427); nothing drives it through an EditorAPI named-style entry point, so a wiring regression (e.g. one of the four paths reverting to `doc.refresh()`, or the cleanup running before the store write) would not fail any test. I grepped the whole repo for `afterNamedStyleChange`, `dropStaleStyleOffAll`, `setDocStyles`, `resetNamedStyle`, `resetAllNamedStyles`, `updateStyleToMatch` and inspected packages/docs/test/store/named-styles.test.ts (store-level only) and packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar-header-footer.test.tsx.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo: `afterNamedStyleChange()` (editor.ts:1052-1060) is a new shared tail invoked from four EditorAPI named-style entry points (editor.ts:2840, 2870, 2875, 2880), each performing store-write-then-cleanup ordering. No test anywhere drives any of those four methods on a real editor. Repo-wide greps for `afterNamedStyleChange`, the four method names, and the store-level style mutators turn up only: store/model-level tests (packages/docs/test/store/named-styles.test.ts, packages/docs/test/model/named-styles.test.ts) and packages/docs/test/model/document.test.ts:390-427, which invokes `doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll()` and `store.updateStyleDefinition` directly; plus packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar-header-footer.test.tsx:51, where `setDocStyles` is a `vi.fn()` stub on a fake EditorAPI (editor fully mocked away). I also checked plausible indirect chains — editor-read-only.test.ts:250-330 (enumerates only applyStyle/insertLink/insertTable), store/entry-parity.test.ts (source-scan limited to block-helper re-exports), shortcuts-catalog.test.ts, pending-style-editor.test.ts, view tests referencing docStyles/StyleId, and frontend .integration.ts suites — none reach the named-style entry points. So the new editor-level wiring and the store-write/cleanup ordering ship with zero meaningful coverage: reverting any of the four call sites to `doc.refresh()` would break no test. Blocking under the test-adequacy rubric as a clear behavior change with no test at the level where it was introduced (the model primitive's own unit tests do not exercise the wiring).

verdict.reason: The internal WAFFLEDOCS_MIME blocks branch of handlePaste calls this.doc.dropStaleStyleOffAll() (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1264), a document-wide mutating sweep, and no test exercises that call site. I enumerated every test in the repo that (a) references the internal clipboard MIME/serializer (clipboard.test.ts — serialize/deserialize only; image-paste-merge.test.ts:97-120 — image-only payload; list-heading-roundtrip.test.ts:454-614 — all payload inlines are `style: {}`, assertions only about type/headingLevel), (b) dispatches a paste event (adds link-trailing-edge.test.ts:126-129 text/plain, editor-read-only.test.ts blocking), and (c) uses clipboardData/getData/pasteContent anywhere in the repo. None pastes a payload carrying an explicit boolean-off flag, so the sweep is a guaranteed no-op in all of them and deleting line 1264 would leave every test green. The only dropStaleStyleOffAll test is a model-level unit test (packages/docs/test/model/document.test.ts:390-427) driven by store.updateStyleDefinition, which exercises the callee in isolation and never the paste wiring. Repo-wide grep for `italic|bold|underline|strikethrough: false` surfaced only one paste-adjacent test (backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:815-858), which is the Cmd+Alt+V format painter, not the clipboard paste branch. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a shipped behavior change on the paste path with no meaningful test covering it.
